faqs.question: How is this different from just building a bilingual website?
faqs.answer: A bilingual build gives you Arabic and English pages; international SEO makes sure each one actually ranks for the people it's meant for. We handle hreflang, native keyword targeting, country signals, and the technical setup that tells search engines which version to show in which language and market — work that goes well beyond putting a language toggle on the page.

faqs.question: What exactly is hreflang and why does it matter?
faqs.answer: hreflang is the signal that tells Google which language and region each page is for, so an Arabic searcher gets your Arabic page and a UAE searcher gets your UAE edition. Done wrong, it's one of the most common causes of the wrong-language page ranking or pages competing against each other. We map, implement, and validate it so the right page wins every time.

faqs.question: Can you help us rank across the wider GCC, not just Oman?
faqs.answer: Yes. We plan the right structure for each market you serve — choosing between subfolders, subdomains, or country domains — and configure geo-targeting and localized content signals for the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and beyond. The goal is for each country and language to surface for its own audience, rather than one market drowning out the rest.

faqs.question: Do you translate keywords, or research them properly in Arabic?
faqs.answer: We research them properly. Arabic search behaviour in the Gulf includes dialect, multiple spellings, transliteration, and frequent English-Arabic mixing, so a translated English keyword list misses real demand. We build the Arabic keyword strategy from how people actually search, then align your pages and metadata to it.

faqs.question: Do we own the work, and how do we get started?
faqs.answer: You own all of it — the on-page changes, hreflang setup, keyword research, and documentation stay with you, with no lock-in to CloudTopia. We start with a free consultation to review your current setup and target markets, walk you through the plan before any commitment, and you can reach us anytime on WhatsApp.
